name: Douglas Schoch
headline: Web GIS Developer & Spatial Data Technologist
tagline: Engineering interactive web maps, automated spatial data pipelines, and visual dashboards across environmental systems, real-time telemetry, and the spatial humanities.
bio: I build interactive Web GIS applications, spatial data pipelines, and custom exploratory tools. With a background spanning environmental law (J.D.), geography, cartography, and full-stack spatial engineering, I specialize in translating complex, fragmented datasets into intuitive, responsive web experiences.
